about: Where each file of the local blackjack engine (game/) comes from. Ported files keep Scout's logic; a token-level diff of each type-stripped port against its Scout blob (whitespace and parentheses ignored) shows only the deviations listed here. Re-check when Scout changes: git -C <scoutgaming> rev-parse <commit>:<path> must still equal blob.

scout.commitNote: origin/main 2026-11-11; the same blobs are unchanged at main 76acbcd9d

ported.deviations: types added; class fields as `declare` (no runtime fields); type-only `!`/`as` in draw(), act(), split(); isBJ and isNatural exported (module-private in Scout) so seats.ts reports naturals and dealer blackjack with the core's own test
types added; canonicalJson reads object keys through a local alias `record`
types added; exported types RandomPort, RngSettings, RngReceipt. Not in the requested list, ported because core imports journaledDraw, rngReceipt and RandomPortError from it

types added (PhysicalCard, ShoeProof, ProofDraw, ClosingEvidence, ShoeVerification); type-only casts. Kept whole (commit/reveal and verifyShoe) because core's shuffle, restoreRound and shoeView use it

types added; local import paths; fail typed `(code, message) => never`; local const aliases of the same objects (port = random, shoe = g.shoe read at use time, f = funding); comments name the lab session instead of Scout's K03 coordinator
types added; withFamily exported; not ported: withMovingOpening, presentationForRow, lineIdOf, reconnectPresentation, resolveMediaFamily*, the rest of filmed-profile

new.basis: scoutgaming test/fixtures/game-random.mjs blob f4c2f7da5c9be7b7d76fed18915ba8fedfb26695 (seededRandom, uuidOf, counter nonce/uuid)
new.purpose: session shoe sources secure | seeded | stacked (lab only, a game-rng replay draw named 'stacked')
the only box 0-6 <-> seat 1-7 conversion; event/view rewriting; totals on deal/reveal events and hands
in-memory single-player session: balance, funding, requestId idempotency, expectedVersion, seat-numbered results

notPorted: services/game/games/blackjack/table/** (coordinator, ports, Postgres store/runtime/wallet, audit chain)
services/game/games/blackjack/native/** (shoe-game single-player variant, Postgres native table)
